about: scripts/recipe_table.py's recipes. task / task_v2 / load are the tags of stored runs (data/task_eval, data/task_load_bench); baseline is the run with the same weights. kl and chat_tok_s are measured numbers carried by hand, with their source in note. A field left out is not measured yet.

recipes.name: TODAY (default)

recipes.note: the bit gates hold here: bits_check --against base, speed_check ALL THE SAME TOKENS, serve_bench --check. The server's default (load_today) is already 3.0 bits a weight and 32 rows: the same load columns as SAFE
